what: two rectangles sharing an edge, both resting on the axis, revolved together (zero-area faces along the axis)
method: the two 30 x 20 rectangles merge into one 60 x 20 region on the axis: a cylinder r = 20, length 60: V = pi 20^2 60, A = 2 pi 20 60 + 2 pi 20^2; 3 faces (side and two disks), none of zero area.
